main.description: Inserts an article draft using private storage (stash). Requires authentication and Striker role - a non-Striker account or a Striker at their drafts limit will be rejected. THIS IS A TEMPORARY UNSPECCED ROUTE, specific to this fork's article-authoring feature.

id.description: The ID of the created draft.

errors.name: NotAStriker
errors.description: The authenticated account does not have the Striker role.

errors.name: ArticleDraftLimitReached
errors.description: Trying to insert a new draft when the limit was already reached.
